purpose: Source-independent release identity authority; a checkout does not certify deployment

currentRuntime.identityRule: Read authenticated runtime health and served frontend identity; match clean source head/tree, build/archive/assets, contract and public/protected snapshot to the dated immutable external release receipt.
currentRuntime.acceptanceRule: The receipt must identify actual clean-browser/API/MCP/model/map/lead/access, telemetry and payload/privacy evidence for that same identity. Health alone is not complete acceptance.
currentRuntime.sourceCheckoutRule: Resolve this checkout with Git. Its own final commit/build cannot be embedded self-referentially here. The external receipt binds the final source revision after build and deployment; the prior accepted identity is not silently promoted.
currentRuntime.retentionRule: Use the dated access sheet and actual configured-expiry readback for current retention, capability rotation and quota headroom. This file does not extend credentials, map expiry or service availability.

dataProfile.publicProfile: Retained immutable public run04; public schema metadata 0.4.0
dataProfile.meaning: Historical immutable public/runtime data identities are retained. New official parcel observation sidecar and actual admission use their own manifest/receipt. Legacy private/protected mode names are not source-rights classifications.
dataProfile.historicalV8AdmissionMeaning: Zero at the historical v8 baseline; new official observation admission is established only by the later exact manifest and external receipt, not by this count.

recordedAccess.capabilityLifetime: Historical separate-delivery policy; superseded by the current approved PR-contained low-privilege access instructions.
recordedAccess.meaning: Historical actual snapshot only; operator/media/evaluator usage shares counters, no reset. Latest external quota/expiry receipt controls current headroom and retention.

recordedAccountObservation.meaning: Dated read-only observation, not an invoice, zero-gross proof or permanent availability promise

strictAgeExample.basis: Disclosed building-year proxy, not roof installation
strictAgeExample.meaning: Dated accepted native/hosted result; compare the actual deployed snapshot and later rehearsal receipt

publicationBoundary: Historical CID1/CID2 public identities; retained run04 and current CLI/Atlas outputs local-only. New upload/Atlas/IPNS/on-chain/registry/shared-MCP effects remain unperformed and separately gated.
submissionBoundary: Local corrected media/PR preparation only. Exact live Human phrase APPROVE P11 V1.1 VIDEO AND DRAFT PR EFFECTS precedes upload/non-force push/draft PR creation. Slowking waits for actual playable approved media, both PRs, PR-contained runtime/access and green CI. No Ready transition or employer message is implied.

historicalP7TechnicalBaseline.receiptLocation: Accepted immutable release packet; not a file supplied by this source checkout
historicalP7TechnicalBaseline.meaning: Dated accepted technical history; any later documentation/source/deployment identity requires its own external receipt. Full source outcomes, media and official submission are separate.

acceptedTechnicalBaseline.meaning: Accepted technical history only. Its masked media/data-boundary interpretation is superseded. No later source, observation admission, deployment or media is certified by this record.

sourceContractAuthority: Read the producer/consumer packages/contracts/contract_manifest.json and match the final external release receipt; do not infer current deployment from this documentation.

evaluatorAccess.mode: Existing low-privilege application capability in the approved draft PR access section
evaluatorAccess.currentQuotaRetentionAndCode: Read the approved PR and dated external access receipt; no static source field extends them.
